newsitem.title: USA: Merisel sees Q4 operating profitability.
newsitem.headline: Merisel sees Q4 operating profitability.

text.p: Merisel Inc said it expects to report a return to operating profitability in the fourth quarter, in spite of relatively flat sales growth compared to the fourth quarter of 1995.
Merisel also said it signed a definitive agreement to sell its Merisel FAB Inc, to Synnex Information Technologies Inc.
Merisel FAB operates Merisel's ComputerLand Franchise and Datago Aggregation Businesses.
The company said the transaction is expected to close within 30 to 60 days. Terms were not disclosed.
On a net basis, the company said it expects to be close to breakeven for the fourth quarter, excluding Merisel FAB's results and any impact from the transaction.
